_comment: NOT NEEDED FOR NORMAL USE, AND UNVERIFIED. On firmware 1.50+ the board becomes two game controllers simply by switching to Dinput mode (hold Start1+P1SW2 for 10 seconds); the pin-to-button mapping is internal and the config block is not involved - a keyboard-mode dump and a Dinput-mode dump are byte-identical. This file exists only for the untested case of wanting custom per-pin gamepad button assignments.
_sticks_note: Stick pins (1up/1down/1left/1right, 2up/...) are deliberately absent. Pins a profile does not mention keep whatever the board already has, so this file will not break your sticks. Whether directions want HAT 0..3, ANALOG 0..7 or GAMEPAD codes is the open question the dump diff answers - add them here once known.
